description: List this workspace warehouses with id, name, description, phone, address (the street line), country (ISO code), city, postalCode, workingHours (free text) and pickupEnabled (whether the warehouse is offered as a self-pickup point). A product lives in at most one warehouse, and the warehouse decides the inventory-tracking default and which sales channels new products are listed on. Use a warehouse id here as the warehouseId for create_product.
name: list_warehouses
title: List warehouses
